summary: DELL target hit (+38.3%) as its Q1 FY2027 blowout ($51.3B AI server backlog, guidance raised to $165–169B) gapped the stock to $441 — all three targets cleared in a single session; IWM short stopped out at $292.03 (−2.4%) as the AI-driven risk-on overrode the SpaceX capital-drain thesis. Three new ideas: HPE and MSFT as read-throughs of the now-validated AI server and software monetization theses; NOC as concentrated defense exposure while Iran MoU remains unsigned and IRGC fires warning shots near Hormuz. BUY at medium conviction — 30Y testing 5.05%, Iran binary still unresolved.

closed_today.note: DELL gapped +39% to $441 at May 29 open on Q1 FY2027 blowout — $43.8B revenue, $16.1B AI server revenue (+757% YoY), $51.3B backlog, FY2027 guide raised to $165–169B. All three targets ($340, $370, $405) cleared simultaneously in the gap. Entry reference $318.80 on May 28.

IWM closed $292.03 on May 28, triggering the $292 daily-close stop. DELL's AH blowout drove broad AI-led risk-on that lifted small-caps through the stop before the SpaceX roadshow drain (begins June 8) could assert. Entry $285.12 on May 26.
